_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/casting/test_legendary_sorcery.py. t_lsor_blast is Urza's Ruinous Blast's restriction on a cheap legendary sorcery that draws a card; t_lsor_instant the same as a legendary instant; t_lsor_legend a vanilla legendary creature; t_lsor_walker a legendary planeswalker; t_lsor_relic a legendary noncreature artifact, which does not count.
